title: Plus Membership Mileage Reduction on Northgate Delivery & Installation
content:
A Plus reduction comes off the per-mile fee charged on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment's road miles beyond the included radius. It follows the membership presented on the purchase being delivered, by that membership's tier as Northgate Memberships records it:

- a purchase that presented a Northgate Business Plus Membership takes $0.30 off each mile;
- a purchase that presented a Northgate Club Plus Membership takes $0.20 off each mile;
- a purchase that presented any other membership takes nothing off.

The reduction comes off the per-mile fee the appointment's miles are charged at, so every mile charged is charged at the reduced fee. Because the reduced per-mile fee is never below $0.60, an appointment beyond the included radius always owes a charge of more than zero.

## Benefit questions

**Which membership counts?** The membership presented on the purchase being delivered, the one recorded on that purchase.

**Does a Northgate Club Membership or a Northgate Business Membership take anything off?** No. Only the two Plus tiers take a reduction; any other membership takes nothing off.

**Is the reduction a percentage?** No. It is a fixed amount off each mile: $0.30 for Business Plus, $0.20 for Club Plus.

## Hypothetical per-mile fees

| Per-mile fee before the reduction | Membership presented | Per-mile fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| $1.50 | Northgate Business Plus Membership | $1.20 |
| $1.50 | Northgate Club Plus Membership | $1.30 |
| $1.50 | Northgate Club Membership | $1.50 |
